notes: Both כִּי clauses are read as prepositional predicates with nominal subjects, so the copulas go to עִם under rule 49's closing paragraph; the competing reading would put *there is* on חֶסֶד and *is* on פְּדוּת.
הַרְבֵּה is read as an adverbial infinitive absolute whose whole contribution the ASV writes as *plenteous*, on the terms of rule 56, and is its own unit headed on that word.
s008: the ASV writes no *the* for הַחֶסֶד, so the article is `unrepresented` under rule 29.
